description: Lebanon – Today, Republican John Schlegel announced his intention to seek re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, continuing his service to 101st Legislative District. Schlegel is currently serving his second term representing the 101st District which consists of Cornwall Borough, North Cornwall Twp., West Cornwall Twp., Lebanon City, North Lebanon Twp., South Lebanon Twp., and West Lebanon Twp. During his tenure, Schlegel has serves on the House Aging and Older Citizens, Child
title: Rep. John Schlegel Announces Re-Election Bid for PA State House
